authorities.productionGate: Verified Preview/Production variable inventory, least privilege, rotation owner, and no secret values in Git
authorities.failureMode: Missing or cross-environment credentials; fail closed
authorities.rollback: Restore the reviewed environment snapshot and promote only a separately verified safe fallback

authorities.productionGate: Released record, ACTIVE observation, approved media/fulfillment, resolver/cart/checkout evidence
authorities.failureMode: Unavailable, stale, or mismatched truth; hide product and deny mutation
authorities.rollback: Withdraw release and restore prior deployment; Shopify changes require separate approval

Required CI / Verify check and approved PR before main

authorities.rollback: Promote the distinct same-SHA/same-release verified safe fallback; never use the captured current Production drift anchor as recovery

authorities.source: next.config.js, server commerce policy, and approved edge/account controls

authorities.source: Versioned, approved content supplied by the legal/content owner
